    Special biserial, string and gentle data (Definitions 3.2 and 3.3) #

    All conditions are stated for left modules over A; for Λ = kQ/I and A = Λᵐᵒᵖ, the path ab (first a, then b) is nonzero in Λ exactly when pval (src a) [a, b] ≠ 0.

    • PathData.IsSpecialBiserial: at most two arrows start and at most two end at each vertex; each arrow has at most one allowed successor and one allowed predecessor.
    • PathData.IsAdmissible: vertices and arrows are nonzero and long paths vanish.
    • MonomialData.IsStringAlgebra: admissible special biserial monomial data (Definition 3.3: I generated by paths).
    • MonomialData.IsGentle: a string algebra whose zero paths are generated in length two and in which each arrow has at most one forbidden successor and one forbidden predecessor.
